episodes.synopsis: Trained all her life, Momoko's skills are finally put to the test as she must battle the oni as they invade in search of a powerful treasure.

episodes.synopsis: The Celestial Maiden Squad and Momoko begin their journey and a face off begins with a formidable enemy.
episodes.title: Demon Combination!? Onihime is Here!

episodes.synopsis: The group is joined by the wizard, Seimei, and his servant, Toutetsu; Onihime enlists the aid of Enki.
episodes.title: One for All and All for One: The Celestial Maiden Squad!

episodes.synopsis: Momoko and Onihime agree to a truce as their groups relax at the beach together.

episodes.synopsis: Momoko and her friends may have met their match; a fortune teller's prediction causes trouble.

episodes.synopsis: The members of Celestial Maiden Squad have become idols and can no longer search for Michimi Peach Fragments.
episodes.title: A Star Is Born! We're the Celestial Maiden Squad!

episodes.synopsis: Onihime's strike causes Momoko to lose the only clue she has to her past and Youki hatches a plan to get all of the Michimi Peach fragments.
episodes.title: Lost! Momoko's Important Thing

episodes.synopsis: The ladies are excited about the medicinal capabilities of a hot spring; a panty thief strikes and Momoko and the others must defeat the culprit.
episodes.title: Peach Plan the Underwear That Disappeared Into the Stream!

episodes.synopsis: Momoko and Onihime learn they have a lot in common and they begin to face the truth of their past.
episodes.title: A Huge Plot Twist! Momo's Secret!

episodes.synopsis: The future looks bleak following the recent defeat and Momoko is still struggling with the truth of her past.
episodes.title: Shocking! Onigashima's Counterattack!!

episodes.synopsis: Momoko and her companions storm Onigashima but are forced to separate, leaving Momoko to face Jakiou.
episodes.title: The Last Battle! Momoko vs Jakiou!!
